ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Anti-Fraud Push
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effectiveness of Minnesota's anti-fraud push and the impact on vulnerable residents.
questions: What are the key challenges in implementing the anti-fraud push?
How effective has the push been in reducing fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant insights into the effectiveness of the anti-fraud push and the challenges faced by the state in implementing it. By analyzing data and public records, we can identify areas where the push has been successful and where improvements are needed.
